name: Carousel
purpose: Cycles through a sequence of slides with previous and next controls.

items.description: Slide content rendered one at a time.

label.description: Accessible label naming the carousel region.

previousLabel.description: Accessible label for the previous control.

nextLabel.description: Accessible label for the next control.

antiPatterns: Do not auto-advance slides without a pause control.
Do not hide critical content only inside non-active slides.

keyboard: Arrow keys move between slides when controls are focused
a11y.focus: Previous and next controls are buttons in tab order.
a11y.labeling: Region has aria-roledescription=carousel and an accessible label.

responsive.strategy: One slide visible per viewport width at all breakpoints.

breakpoints.compact: Full-width slide with large touch targets.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Direction inherits from document lang/dir.
